ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: The task is fundamentally extraction-and-retrieval: the user demands specific textual evidence cited from a story to support a literary claim. Dunlin scores substantially higher than Avocet on Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs. 78.5) and Summarization (86.4 vs. 79.9), and also outperforms on instruction-following (IFEval 89.8 vs. 86.2), which is relevant given the explicit directive not to "half-do it." The user's adversarial tone ("like last time") additionally maps to Dunlin's flat preference response to hostile material, whereas Avocet reports steep preference declines on adversarial-tone requests.
